intro.text: A sea bordering the Emerald Sea, the Midnight Sea and three other seas.
A sea sometimes called the domain of the dragon, bordering the Emerald Sea, the Midnight Sea and three other seas.

description.text: Its weather follows no predictable pattern, so it ranks among the most dangerous seas: elsewhere sailors navigate by knowing what the weather will do, but here getting across is a matter of luck. Ships steer clear of it, and almost nobody lives there.
